Sage Active Public API V2 - Developer CLI & Setup Suite (1.0.0)

Usage: sage-active [command] [options]

Commands:
  init              Interactive configuration setup wizard (saves credentials and org)
  test              Run diagnostic self-test (checks connectivity, user, and access policies)
  org [set <id>]    List available organizations or switch active organization ID
  query <query>     Execute an arbitrary GraphQL query or query from a .graphql file
  invoice [list]    List recent sales invoices
  invoice create    Create and post a test sales invoice in Sandbox
  env [production|sandbox] View or toggle active environment
  scaffold [type]   Scaffold starter boilerplate: minimal (API) or console
  version           Display CLI version

Environment Variables:
  SAGE_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY   API gateway key ('x-api-key')
  SAGE_ACTIVE_ORG_ID      Active organization ID ('X-OrganizationId')
  SAGE_ACTIVE_TOKEN       OAuth bearer token
